items.title: Yemen's Houthis attack Saudis, seize crucial Red Sea islands
items.description: Iran-backed Houthi rebels have tightened their grip on a key shipping route, capturing two strategic Red Sea islands. The closure of another global transport route is the latest ripple effect of the US war with Iran.

items.title: Europe launches two climate observation satellites
items.description: The European Space Agency has put two satellites into orbit to take a closer look at the impact of climate change. One of them will focus particularly on plant life.

items.title: Arctic power plays: EU searches for a new strategy

items.title: EU leaders urge unity after Russian strike on train
items.description: Russia's drone attack on a train near the Ukraine-Poland border has triggered EU calls to up support for Kyiv. Allies of Ukraine should show they "are not scared," said the bloc's top diplomat, Kaja Kallas.
